title: ChainInsight
tagline: ChainInsight is an AI-powered onchain platform that personalizes investment baskets and automates trading based on your risk profile using secure MPC wallets, custom API calls, and AgentKit for a transparent, dynamic DeFi experience.
description: ChainInsight is a decentralized finance solution that transforms the investment journey by merging personalization with automation. Users begin by answering a short, three-question risk profile survey. Based on their responses, our AI engine curates a custom basket of onchain investment ideas, similar to small-case portfolios, perfectly tailored to their risk appetite. Simultaneously, ChainInsight’s automated trading agent uses three user-defined parameters to execute dynamic trading strategies and issue real-time market alerts. Built on blockchain technology, the platform ensures full transaction transparency and leverages MPC wallets for enhanced security. With streamlined API integration and optional AgentKit connectivity, ChainInsight provides a seamless, adaptive, and secure trading experience for both novice and seasoned investors.
how_its_made:
ChainInsight is built at the intersection of blockchain, AI, and advanced trading automation:

AI & Risk Profiling:
We developed an AI engine that begins with a brief three-question survey to determine a user’s risk appetite. The engine then dynamically curates a personalized basket of investment ideas based on these inputs.

Automated Trading Agent:
Our trading agent is engineered to execute trades automatically using three custom, user-defined parameters. This agent is programmed to monitor market conditions in real time and send alert signals for strategic decision-making.

Blockchain Integration & Security:
All transactions and trading actions are executed onchain, providing complete transparency and auditability. We integrated secure MPC (Multi-Party Computation) wallets to safeguard user funds during trading operations.

API & AgentKit Connectivity:
By leveraging streamlined API calls and optional AgentKit integration, we ensure our platform is flexible, customizable, and easy to integrate with other onchain applications.

Tech Stack:
The backend is powered by Node.js combined with Web3 libraries for blockchain interactions, while our smart contracts are optimized for efficient onchain execution. This integration of partner technologies allowed us to create a hacky, yet robust, solution that meets the evolving needs of the DeFi space.
